purpose: Candidate events for dates that are already occupied in data/events.json. These are source-backed reserve entries for future support of alternate facts, regional editions, topic packs, or a deeper archive.

candidates.title: Uster: stainless hangers fail above a pool
candidates.summary: A suspended concrete ceiling collapsed into the indoor pool at Uster, Switzerland, killing 12 people. Chrome-nickel-steel hangers had suffered chloride-driven corrosion and stress-corrosion cracking in the humid pool atmosphere.
candidates.lesson: Stainless is not corrosion-proof. Safety-critical hidden components need material selection and inspection matched to the real atmosphere, not the material's marketing name.
candidates.notes: SRF provides accessible anniversary/context coverage; BGE 115 IV 199 is stronger for technical facts: 207 chrome-nickel-steel hangers, acidic chloride-containing moisture film, pitting, transcrystalline stress-corrosion cracking, overloading, 12 deaths and 19 injured or directly endangered.

candidates.title: Mitholz: stored ammunition remains an active system
candidates.summary: Part of the ammunition stored in the Swiss Army's underground Mitholz depot exploded, killing nine people and damaging the village. Thousands of tonnes of munition remnants remain a long-term clearance and risk-management problem.
candidates.lesson: Hazardous storage does not become safe because it is abandoned or buried. Inventory, degradation, confinement, water ingress and future access remain engineering responsibilities for decades.
candidates.notes: The explosion occurred during the night of 19/20 December 1947. Stored as 12-19 for now because armasuisse states December 1947 and other sources identify 19 December; 12-20 is also occupied by EBR-I.
